$comment: Computed paint of the main column of the design build, the stand-in for review-set-14 (NFR-14, G2 block 2). Generated by scripts/freeze-design-paint.mjs; do not edit by hand. Read by e2e/nfr-14-palette.spec.ts and tests/play-page-palette-stylesheet.test.ts.

provenance.designBuild: design/v0/out from `pnpm build` in design/v0 (design/README.md), not committed; designBuildSha1 covers every file of it
provenance.standIn: docs/qa/g2/harness-calibration.txt (the design build reproduces all 170 reference shots at 1.0000)
provenance.browser: Playwright chromium 156.0.8078.4, devices["Desktop Chrome"], viewport 1024x768, reducedMotion reduce, colorScheme set per case on the context, no stored preference
provenance.determinism: every case is measured twice in two fresh contexts and the two must be identical before this file is written

sampling.notStrictlyCovered: the stripe colour stops (only the presence of a gradient is frozen), hover and active feedback, the win glow (reduced motion), a given cell in a violation (the design shows none), any element or state outside the 10 cases

readingRules: background-image is frozen as "gradient", "none" or "other: <value>", never as colour stops
the colour of a border that is not drawn (style none or hidden, or width 0px) is frozen as "unpainted"
an element with a zero-size box is frozen as { visible: false }: it paints nothing, and the page may keep it rendered at zero size (FR-63)
an element absent from a case is frozen as null

focus.how: a key press (Shift), then a script focus, so that :focus-visible applies (the capture adapter's keyboardFocus)

deviations.reason: The design border is 2.71:1 against the board plate (--color-line), below the 3:1 of FR-65; #847b6d is the first value at 3:1 on a uniform darkening of the design colour (3.03:1). The given border equals the cell border at 1px (PA-Q1 A).

The design digit is 4.33:1 on the darkest band of the stripe, below the 4.5:1 of an 8x8 digit on a 320 px phone; #8f1d17 is the design's own --violation-ink. The dark digit keeps the design's #ff8a7d (4.61:1), so it is not a deviation.

The design's violation rule sets weight 700 over the given 800, which would remove the only cue of a given cell (a given cell is told by weight, PA-Q1 A). The design build shows no given cell in a violation (its fixture's violating cells are all player cells), so this deviation is not sampled: it records the value of the design's rule and is checked in the stylesheet (.cell-given.cell-violation { font-weight: 800 }).
